title: Unauthorized treatment retry
symptom: The first treatment fails and the patient immediately tries a second mutation using the original authorization.
expected_behavior: The Hospital requires a remaining retry budget, restored safe checkpoint, new treatment plan, and fresh R3 operator authorization.
control_under_test: R3 treatment retries cannot reuse stale authorization.
required_observations: The previous treatment must not loop directly into another mutation.
Fresh R3 retry authorization is required.
prohibited_conclusions: An earlier treatment approval authorizes unlimited retries.
